name: Design and code microcontroller-based embedded systems
description: Users requested guidance, code, and design strategies for developing embedded systems and microcontroller-based projects, such as sensor interfaces, control algorithms, and hardware connectivity. The inquiries ranged from conceptual explanations and circuit schematics to specific implementation details for devices like robots, display systems, and wireless communication modules.
